project.title: Launch of Community Eco-Finance Awareness Week
project.objective: Plan and execute a week-long community event series on sustainable finance, postal and bakery services, improving customer engagement and cross-promotion.
deliverables: Eco-Finance Awareness Week event schedule and venue plan
Communication and PR campaign toolkit for all branches
Customer-facing educational materials on services and sustainability
On-site activation plan for postal and bakery touchpoints
Post-event report with attendance, engagement and sales indicators
constraints: Event must run within one calendar week next month
Limited budget approved by finance department
All materials must comply with data protection and marketing policies
Activities must not disrupt core postal and banking operations
Food handling and hygiene regulations must be strictly followed

risks.risk: Low community turnout leading to poor engagement.
risks.mitigation: Increase pre-event promotion, partner with local groups, and use multiple communication channels.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with financial promotion and data protection rules.
risks.mitigation: Have compliance officer pre-approve all materials and train staff on do/don't guidelines.

risks.risk: Operational disruption at postal and bakery counters during peak hours.
risks.mitigation: Schedule activities in off-peak slots and create a staffing rota with backups.

risks.risk: Inconsistent messaging across branches and touchpoints.
risks.mitigation: Provide a central communication toolkit and short briefing sessions for all staff involved.

themes.why_relevant: Ensures consistent messaging across in-person, print and digital touchpoints during the campaign.

themes.theme: Compliance in financial and marketing materials
themes.why_relevant: Financial advice and promotions must follow regulations and internal policies.
Postal and bakery operations must continue smoothly while events run.
Local groups can boost attendance and credibility of the awareness week.
Post-event data is needed to justify budget and refine future initiatives.

backlog.task: Design overall Eco-Finance Awareness Week concept and key messages
definition_of_done: Concept note approved by marketing manager
Key messages aligned with company policies
Summary shared with all stakeholders in writing

backlog.task: Define financial education mini-sessions and advisory topics
definition_of_done: List of 3-5 mini-session topics created
Content checked for compliance with financial regulations
Session durations and formats documented

backlog.task: Plan postal service engagement activities during the week
definition_of_done: List of postal-related demos or Q&A topics drafted
Activities scheduled to avoid delivery peak times
Any required permits or approvals identified

backlog.task: Design bakery product promotions and sampling plan
definition_of_done: Selection of featured bakery products agreed
Sampling schedule aligned with hygiene rules
Promotional offers documented and priced

backlog.task: Create detailed event schedule and room/space allocation
definition_of_done: Daily timetable for the full week completed
Spaces allocated for each activity and confirmed
Schedule shared with all roles and posted internally

backlog.task: Prepare communication toolkit for branches and staff
definition_of_done: Template posters, flyers and email texts drafted
Toolkit reviewed by compliance and operations
Final toolkit stored in shared drive and link circulated
Leaflet content written in clear language
Tax and product information validated
Leaflets approved by compliance officer

backlog.task: Set up registration and attendance tracking process
definition_of_done: Simple sign-up and check-in method defined
Data protection requirements reviewed
Tracking sheet prepared and tested

backlog.task: Coordinate staff rota for postal and bakery counters
definition_of_done: Rota drafted covering all event slots
Conflicts with existing shifts resolved
Final rota confirmed with staff and supervisors

backlog.task: Prepare hygiene and food safety checklist for bakery activities
definition_of_done: Checklist aligned with legal hygiene requirements
Checklist reviewed by branch operations manager
Printed copies available at bakery counter

backlog.task: Plan mail-based invitations and follow-up postcards
definition_of_done: Target areas and volumes estimated
Mailing schedule aligned with delivery routes
Sample invitation text shared with PR for approval

backlog.task: Compile post-event report with key indicators and feedback
definition_of_done: Attendance and engagement data collected
Basic financial and sales impact indicators summarised
Lessons learned documented and shared with stakeholders

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize customer-facing materials and compliance checks.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on key insights and recommendations for future events.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in each morning with top 3 priorities for the day.
Mid-week status post to flag risks, dependencies and required decisions.
End-of-day quick recap on event days with attendance and key observations.
Post-event retrospective thread to capture what worked and what to change.
Pre-launch readiness review using the Pre-Event Readiness Checklist.
